description: Meme promoting the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers as the builder of a border wall. A dozen soldiers in Army dress uniforms stand in front of a large red castle structure (the Corps of Engineers castle insignia rendered as a set-piece), with flags and lances at left. Overlaid text touts the Corps as one of the world's largest public engineering agencies, with the hashtag #BuildTheWall along the left edge.
text: US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS. One of the world's largest public engineering, design, and construction management agencies. #BuildTheWall. WE BUILD STUFF FOR NATIONAL DEFENSE.

description: Mobile Safari screenshot (mobile.twitter.com, dated Feb 20) of a tweet thread. UK Labour politician John McDonnell MP replies to the thread with the single letter 'Q', timestamped Feb 20, 2019.
text: Feb 20. mobile.twitter.com. Search Twitter. Ed Poole @edwardpoole1975 · 23h.
